I want Elise to find someone who truly deserves her in Season 2.

As much as I LOVE the undeniable chemistry between Elise and Anya, I want Elise to experience what it’s like to be someone’s first choice. Someone who’s willing to fight for her, choose her without hesitation, and love her openly instead of constantly leaving her guessing where she stands in this never-ending bestie situationship.

I want Anya to see Elise genuinely happy with someone else. Not because I want Anya to suffer, but because I want her to finally realize what she’s been taking for granted. Elise has always been there for her, through all the bantering, mixed signals, emotional push-and-pull, and moments when Anya needed someone to lean on. And somehow, Elise always ends up putting her own feelings aside.

Anya needs an awakening. She needs to understand that just because someone has always been there doesn’t mean they’ll always be waiting. You can’t keep someone emotionally attached while refusing to give them the love and certainty they deserve.

And Elise? She needs to be selfish for once. She needs to stop settling for crumbs when she deserves the whole damn cake. I want to see her being pursued, appreciated, and loved without having to question whether those feelings are reciprocated.

And if Anya finally realizes she’s in love with Elise? Then I want her to EARN her way back into Elise’s heart. Not with jealousy, not with another round of mixed signals, but with actual growth, vulnerability, and the courage to fight for her.

Because Elise deserves to be chosen, not just needed. And Anya needs to learn the difference between having someone’s heart and actually taking care of it.

In the name of Quinn Shepard, Amen.
